title: malus pashia
intro: Malus pashia, commonly known as the Indian wild apple or Chinese apple, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and traditional Chinese medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malus pashia include its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions due to its bioactive constituents. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
